filename: T1C+ - Petrous ridge meningioma petrous ridge , ventricle 010.jpg
description:
3.4 cm enhancing convex mass with underlying bony irregularity adjacent to the right petrous ridge.

The mass covers the right internal auditory meatus.

The 4th ventricle is effaced as it the brainstem, due to mass effect.

The supratentorial brain is normal.
